lesson.title: Procedure 107 – GAS AVAILABILITY INFORMATION
objectives: Relay gas availability using required phrasing and positive-only broadcasts.
Apply Out-of-Service handling and monitoring responsibilities.
Input station house locations using 68Q1/68Q2 and create/assign the event.
